newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comm Intl unit gets Sumo tour rights.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comm Intl unit gets Sumo tour rights.

text.p: Tele-Communications International Inc said that its Japanese programming subsidiary, Jupiter Programming Co Ltd, has acquired the rights to the professional Sumo wrestling tour for undisclosed terms.
Jupiter will broadcast the tournaments via satellite and cable on its new sports channel, which it expects to launch by the end of the year.
"This is one more step in our goal to consolidate our sports interests in Japan," TINTA Executive Vice President Miranda Curtis said in a statement.
Jupiter is a 50-50 joint venture between Tele-Communications International Inc and Sumitomo Corp.
